notes:
Lead background:
- SMB, B2B helpdesk SaaS (customer-facing chat + agent-assist). Mobile web widget + agent desktop.
- Onboarded via self-serve; small engineering team (2 backend + 1 frontend) experimenting with chat completion.

Primary ask: latency is too high for core chat flows. CEO said: "users notice pauses on reply, drop-off on mobile". Goal: reduce perceived reply time to <400ms p50 for single-turn suggestions.

Observed details (from support/SE):
- Default requests currently hitting eu-west region; product audience ~75% NA.
- Typical request shape: 1 system + 4 user messages with context; prompt ~900–1400 tokens; max_tokens set to 512.
- Measured p50 ~650ms in NA (via client-side timing), p95 spikes 1.8–2.4s; EU deployments show consistent 800ms+ p50 depending on route.
- Throughput low: ~5–12 reqs/sec during peaks, cost-sensitive.

Recommendations already discussed (to be validated in POC):
- Region change: route requests from NA users to us-east region for lower RTT (customer agreed to test).
- Prompt guidance: move long, static context into server-side retrieval + cache embeddings; send only recent turns + retrieved doc snippets. Target prompt <= 600 tokens.
- Adjust max_tokens & stop sequences to avoid over-generation; reduce default max_tokens to 128 for quick replies.
- Enable streaming in the client to improve perceived latency for longer responses.
- Client timeouts: set HTTP connect timeout 2s, total request timeout 10s; abort and backoff for retries (avoid cascading retries).
- Use token caching for repeated system prompts and KB snippets.

POC scope:
- 1 engineer to implement region header override + streaming demo
- 1-week telemetry: compare p50/p95 before vs after region + short prompt changes
- Success criteria: p50 below 400ms for NA traffic and no more than 15% p95 > 1s; same or lower token cost per session.

Quotes / snippets from calls:
- "If we can shave 200–300ms consistently the engagement metric improves" (Head of Product).
- "We tried increasing client-side polling but it made retries worse" (platform eng).

Open items / risks:
- Procurement asks for SOC2 reference before committing to monthly pricing (we provided security doc link).
- Engineering bandwidth limited; need example diff/snippet to drop-in streaming + region header.
- They use a 3rd-party routing proxy (cloudflare worker) that may mask client IPs; SE recommended server-side routing by user region.
